crosswalks.historical_boundary: Medieval County of Flanders, including the core East/West/Roman Flanders areas represented by the EU5 flanders_area aggregate
crosswalks.resolution_method: Mapped all 15 EU5 locations with area=flanders_area. The historical county's 1300 castellany and urban boundaries are not recoverable as a single exact polygon from the cited sources; the unmapped/overlap area therefore remains explicitly unresolved rather than being silently rescaled.

area_comparison.area_difference_policy: No population or capacity aggregate is area-rescaled; this crosswalk is validation-only.

crosswalks.notes: The selector includes cities and rural hinterlands together. Because the source's 550,000 estimate explicitly includes about 150,000 urban residents, this mapping cannot supervise intrinsic rural capacity.
